question_text: What is the average order value across all regions?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(net_revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS aov FROM v_orders

question_text: What is the average order value for customers in Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(net_revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS aov FROM v_orders WHERE country = 'Germany'

question_text: What is the repeat customer rate overall?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count >= 2) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS repeat_rate FROM v_customers

question_text: What is the overall return rate?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(returned_amount) / SUM(gross_revenue) AS return_rate FROM v_orders

question_text: What is the return rate for the United Kingdom?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(returned_amount) / SUM(gross_revenue) AS return_rate FROM v_orders WHERE country = 'United Kingdom'

question_text: Which are the top 3 selling products by revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, description, total_revenue FROM v_products ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 3

question_text: Which are the 3 worst-selling products by revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, description, total_revenue FROM v_products ORDER BY total_revenue ASC, product_id ASC LIMIT 3

question_text: How many units of product 85123A have been sold, net of returns?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM v_order_lines WHERE product_id = '85123A'

question_text: How many total units have been sold across the whole catalog, net of returns?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM v_order_lines

question_text: What was the revenue growth rate from 2010 to 2011?
gold_sql: WITH yearly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS yr, SUM(net_revenue) AS rev FROM v_orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) IN (2010, 2011) GROUP BY yr) SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2011 THEN rev END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2010 THEN rev END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2010 THEN rev END) AS growth_rate FROM yearly

question_text: What is the lifetime value of customer 17850?
gold_sql: SELECT lifetime_revenue AS clv FROM v_customers WHERE customer_id = '17850'

question_text: Which 5 customers have the highest lifetime value?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, lifetime_revenue FROM v_customers ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 5

question_text: What is the total revenue generated by the Christmas & Seasonal category, net of returns?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM v_order_lines WHERE category = 'Christmas & Seasonal'

question_text: How many distinct orders were placed by customers in France?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM v_orders WHERE country = 'France'

question_text: What is the average order value for international customers outside the United Kingdom?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(net_revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS aov FROM v_orders WHERE country != 'United Kingdom'

question_text: What was the revenue growth rate from 2010 to 2011 for markets outside the United Kingdom?
gold_sql: WITH yearly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS yr, SUM(net_revenue) AS rev FROM v_orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) IN (2010, 2011) AND country != 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY yr) SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2011 THEN rev END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2010 THEN rev END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2010 THEN rev END) AS growth_rate FROM yearly

question_text: Which non-UK country generated the most revenue overall?
gold_sql: SELECT country, SUM(net_revenue) AS revenue FROM v_orders WHERE country != 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY country ORDER BY revenue DESC, country ASC LIMIT 1

question_text: What is the return rate for customers outside the United Kingdom?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(returned_amount) / SUM(gross_revenue) AS return_rate FROM v_orders WHERE country != 'United Kingdom'

question_text: What is the average order value for repeat customers only?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.net_revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS aov FROM v_orders o JOIN v_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.order_count >= 2

question_text: Which product category has the highest total revenue, net of returns?
gold_sql: SELECT category, SUM(line_revenue) AS revenue FROM v_order_lines GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC, category ASC LIMIT 1
